systems.system: Je Suis Citoyen Béninois card drive
systems.country_label: campagne d'aide à l'obtention des cartes Cip et C'est Moi
systems.owner: NGO Je Suis Citoyen Béninois; cards issued by ANIP
systems.tiers: nine communes (Lokossa, Bopa, Kouffo, Zè, Toffo, Allada, N'Dali, Pèrèrè, Sô-Ava), September 2025 to May 2026; over 130,000 people helped to a CIP or C'est Moi card, 1,995 at Sô-Ava; defective fingerprints, RAVIP numbers that did not work and no tablets in some arrondissements
thousands enrolled in it still had no CIP or C'est Moi card

note: An NGO drive for identity cards among people already enrolled; nothing on the registration of births or deaths.
